Implementation PR: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/pull/73

Independent unit and separate final checkers accepted candidate `8a47fc863d72f06c7e0ec3dc380697a8a351724c` (base `4ea747ffa215f8057d12aa5525ba0e4497961e7d`, plan 1). Final checking passed all 252 CPU tests in each Linux Debug/Release and exceptions OFF/ON configuration, 69 planned cases repeated three times, 20 ASan+UBSan cases, actual original-header callers, the 38-input production startup corpus and the unchanged startup regression probe. No new findings.

Native Windows verification was explicitly user-waived and remains unverified. This is bounded Linux CPU/compatibility evidence; no GPU, Steam, complete parser-security, persistence or general binary ABI claim. Parent #8 remains open. Issue #18 remains open pending merged delivery.

Final report: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/harness-artifacts/runs/issue-18/issue18-20261102/reports/check-final-1.json
